LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_GenerationChanceTip: Generation chance ranges from 0 to 1; for example, 0.35 means 35%.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_InvalidGenerationChance: Generation chance must be a valid number between 0 and 1.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_InvalidCountRange: Spawn count must be at least 1, and the maximum cannot be below the minimum.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlaceOnMapTip: Configure count, chance and arrival method, then choose a generation point on the map. The point is included when you save the map.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_MemberStatusTip: You can plan for members before they are generated. Dead or missing members cannot be selected. Movement also requires the pawn to be spawned on the destination map and able to stand.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_CannotSelectUnavailable: This member cannot be selected: {0}. Choose another member, or generate a new one and try again.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_MapRequired: Open a map in developer mode before placing an entity spawn point.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlacementBlocked: Choose a walkable cell inside the map.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlacementOccupied: This cell already contains a building or entity spawn point. Choose another cell.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlacementFailed: The entity spawn point could not be placed. See the log for details.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlacementDescription: Click a map cell to place the spawn configuration. For damage or destruction triggers, choose the building that should trigger generation; use an empty cell for other recipes. No pawns or spawn events run now. The configuration is included in the map export. You can then edit it or use a member in a cinematic.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlacementMissing: This spawn point has been removed and can no longer be edited.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlacementMemberTip: Choose a member in its actual generation order, starting at 1. Numbering belongs to the entire source within the current quest, rather than this individual spawn point. Repeated use of the same recipe continues the numbering. You can record movement before generation and assign a rehearsal pawn separately in the actor window.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlacementAddActor: Add this member as an actor
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlacementQuestMismatch: The current cinematic belongs to another quest. Set its quest to match this map in project settings before adding a member.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PlacementBuildingRequired: This recipe generates pawns when a building is damaged or destroyed. Place the spawn point on the building that should trigger it.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Undo_Tip: Undo the latest change to steps, settings, actors, or subtitles. Continuous typing is grouped into one edit.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Redo_Tip: Reapply the change you just undid.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_ProjectSettings_Tip: Open project settings at any time to choose a quest, change playback rules, and manage named locations.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_DraftSaved: Cinematic draft saved. Unfinished subtitles are preserved too.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_DraftSaveFailed: Could not save the cinematic draft
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_DraftLoadFailed: Could not restore the cinematic draft. A recovery copy of the original file is kept at: {0}
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestFormalSelected: Test selected step: formal actor sources
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestFailureFocused: The authoring scene has been restored and the failed step is selected. Adjust its properties and test again.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_LocateLocation_Tip: Move the camera to this location. Locations retain their recorded world and map.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_LocationInUse: This location is used by a step. Change that step’s target before removing the location.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_DraftRecoveryFailed: The cinematic draft could not be restored or preserved as a recovery copy. Disk draft writes for this world are blocked; see the log for details.
